decision: Stage 3 must fix the five gaps of coverage judge rm-coverage-judge-1794599377 (coverage_verdict.json, 2026-11-13T19:49Z; all return_to 3, criterion sound, cost edit) and write a NEW coverage_fixes.json against that judge, one claim per gid. g1: sc_floor_end_shock adds a hauler whose path crosses a LIVE cord cell at least two cells from its end, expected NOT shocked (rules out whole-cord shock) [scenes.json sc_floor_end_shock; tree.json floor_end_shocks_crossers]. g2: test each agent ruling in d_shock_reach_agent_detail that sheet.md's delegated line tells the player, or cut the untested ones from sheet.md and record.json: (a) the live end of a run the player stopped laying shocks a crosser; (b) a pawn delivering steel to the joining blueprint, path across the live end, is safe; (c) a floor end does not light a chemfuel puddle (sc_fuel_ignition); (d) shock is not limited by maxSparkingEnds; (e) FlowWorks collapsed-deck cords shock under 'Only downed lines' and are silent under None (sc_shock_reach). Give ruling (6) one meaning: 'never the spark budget' vs 'only if it is drawn live'. g3: sc_no_sharp_turn expect (and no_unforced_sharp_turn oracle_proposed) also requires the sc_cords_slack read on the same strands in each look: drawn length/chord >= 1.4 and the off-line excursion, so taut cords fail. g4 (late): sc_owner_change adds a same-owner span not touching the handed-over mast, which stays linked and powered with cutWiresOnOwnerChange on while the two spans to the claimed mast are cut [tree.json owner_change_coils_wires]. g5 (late): sc_statics_new_game also reads the printed-section statics (section keys, strand names) and the live-wire path-cost table by map id: filled in game 1, empty at the start of the new game and of the loaded tap-free game, refilled by the game-1 reload control; or narrow record.json game_statics_reset to what is tested.
summary: No lock: concept_tree gate refuses (no coverage signature). The pre-launch coverage judge rm-coverage-judge-1794599377 found every earlier gap fixed but returned not_covered with 5 new sound, edit-cost gaps (3 in changed scenes, 2 late). Its brief is uncalibrated, so the refusal is advisory and does not force a return, but there is no route to a signature without it, and stage 5 cannot edit the frozen artifacts. Returning to stage 3 to fix all five in one run. No owner question. Caution: the next not_covered may hit the judge's round limit (REFUSAL_NOTHING_COULD_EVER_PASS), so stage 3 should fix the list whole.
